family.description: This family contains proteins found in SARS and SARS-like coronaviruses. It includes uncharacterised protein 14 from SARS coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2), human SARS coronavirus (SARS-CoV) and bat coronavirus Rp3/2004 (SARS-like coronavirus Rp3) [[cite:PUB00094078]]. In SARS-CoV, orf14 is completely contained within the ORF encoding the nucleocapsid protein (N) [[cite:PUB00094078]]. In SARS-CoV-2 uncharacterised protein 14 is predicted to contain one transmembrane helix.
family.name: Betacoronavirus uncharacterised protein 14 (SARS-CoV-2 like)
